title: Padding
definition: Utilities for controlling the padding (inner spacing) of an element.
simpleExplanation: Stuffing. Padding pushes your OWN content away from your OWN borders. If a button has no padding, the text touches the border. Adding `p-4` gives the text room to breathe inside the button.
realWorldExample: Creating a beautiful pill-shaped button using `px-6 py-2` (more padding on the sides than the top).

basic: What is the difference between Margin and Padding?
intermediate: If you apply a background color to an element, does the background color cover the Margin area or the Padding area?

answers.question: Margin vs Padding?
answers.answer: Margin is OUTSIDE the border (pushes other elements away). Padding is INSIDE the border (pushes inner text/content away from the edge).

answers.question: Background color?
answers.answer: It covers the Padding area. The Margin area is always transparent.

codeExample: Text has plenty of breathing room from the border!
